title: Organization of the Nervous System
definition: The nervous system is organized into central and peripheral divisions.
description: Each part has a specific role in detecting, processing, and responding to information.
think_prompt: Why is the nervous system divided into different parts?
quick_check: What are the two main divisions of the nervous system?
answer: Central nervous system and peripheral nervous system

title: Central and peripheral nervous system
definition: CNS includes the brain and spinal cord; PNS connects the body to the CNS.
description: These systems work together to coordinate activity across the body.
think_prompt: Which structures make up the CNS?
quick_check: Name the two major divisions of the nervous system.

title: Brain and spinal cord
definition: The brain and spinal cord receive, process, and coordinate information from the body.
description: The CNS acts as the control centre of the nervous system.
think_prompt: Which organ system acts as the control centre of the body?
quick_check: What are the two major parts of the CNS?
